window-planter.label: Window Planter
window-planter.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
window-planter.notes: A timber flower box 0.8 m by 0.25 m, with a row of violet, cream and mauve blossoms. The footprint is the box body; the blossoms overhang it.

mossy-boulder.label: Mossy Boulder
mossy-boulder.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
mossy-boulder.notes: A rounded grey stone 0.8 m across with a moss cap on top. The widest belly overhangs the proposed footprint by about 0.05 m.

tree-stump.label: Tree Stump
tree-stump.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
tree-stump.notes: A cut stump 0.5 m across with bark sides, a pale ringed cut top and a small moss cap on one edge. The root flare overhangs the footprint by about 0.05 m.

stream-reeds.label: Stream Reeds
stream-reeds.pivot: ground centre of the mud bed
stream-reeds.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
stream-reeds.notes: A clump of six one-voxel reeds, 0.6 m to 1.0 m tall, with brown seed heads and teal-green blades. No footprint: reeds stand at the water's edge.
